summary: This 8-K by 21Shares XRP ETF reports routine operational changes: on August 20, 2026, the sponsor entered a Benchmark Licensing Agreement with FTSE International to replace the CME CF XRP-Dollar Reference Rate with the FTSE XRP Index for fund valuation, effective August 27, 2026. Additionally, Amendment No. 1 to the Sponsor Agreement changes sponsor fee payment timing from weekly to at least quarterly, payable in XRP. Also included is an amendment to the trust's governing documents. These are ordinary administrative/contractual updates for a fund, not a special-situation corporate event. No acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender, or restructuring is involved. No deal terms apply.
